text: dsh-turn-trace 是面向 DSH Web 会话界面的轮次费用账本，在会话中增加 Turns 标签页。它读取已有聊天快照，把用户输入、模型步骤和工具调用按轮次与步骤整理，并依记录的模型、token 用量和时间估算每步及整轮费用。展开条目可查看调用状态、耗时、参数、结果和来源，也可翻阅较早历史、查看缓存节省并切换美元与人民币显示。适合需要逐轮了解 DeepSeek Harness 会话开销的用户；估价依据内置费率，不是实际账单。

dsh-turn-trace adds a Turns tab to DSH Web sessions. It groups chat data into turns, model steps, and tool calls, then estimates costs from recorded tokens, models, and timestamps. Inspect calls, review cache savings, page through history, and switch USD/CNY display. Prices are estimates, not bills.

dsh-turn-trace「按轮次和步骤估价」：每轮可展开为模型步骤，显示 token 用量、估算金额、缓存节省及调用耗时；费用按记录的模型和调用时间计算。
dsh-turn-trace「检查调用详情」：点击用户输入、模型或工具调用可打开详情面板，查看位置、时间、模型、参数与结果等记录。
dsh-turn-trace「翻阅更早轮次」：Turns 列表按时间倒序分页；点 Older 可在当前历史窗口耗尽时请求载入更早会话记录。
dsh-turn-trace「切换显示货币」：顶部按钮可在 USD 与 CNY 间切换费用显示，并保存所选货币供后续显示使用。
dsh-turn-trace 使用内置费率估算费用而非账单金额；价格按工作日时段变化，未建模的中国公共假期可能使估值偏高。

dsh-turn-trace README · What it does：- Turns are a list, collapsed. Each row is money and step count.
- Expand a turn: every step shows `Step i/n`, its tokens, and its money.
- Inside a step: the calls it made — `llm · model · 6.4s`, `bash · ok · 41s`.

Tools do not consume tokens. A step's tokens always belong to its model call, which is why the money sits on the step, not on the tool.

dsh-turn-trace README · Why not just use Trajectory?：Trajectory answers *when*: the event ledger and timing. Turns answers *how much*: each step's tokens and money, plus the calls that step made. It is additive — Chat and Trajectory stay exactly where they are.

Playback, wall-clock Gantts, and cross-session dashboards are deliberately out of scope; those already have better homes.

dsh-turn-trace README · Install：Requires the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (Homebrew cask `deepseek-harness`) or any `dsh` profile that serves the Web UI.

```sh
dsh-turn-trace README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-turn-trace

dsh-turn-trace README · from a local checkout：git clone https://github.com/nrenvo/dsh-turn-trace
cd dsh-turn-trace
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:$PWD
```

Restart the app, open a session, and click **Turns** next to Chat and Trajectory.

dsh-turn-trace README · What you see：| Level | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Header | turn count, session total, cache savings, USD/CNY switch |
| Pager | ten turns per page, newest first; **Older** pulls the next history window |
| Turn | step count, wall-clock duration, money, money saved by cache |
| Step | `Step i/n`, money, tokens in/out, cache savings, priciest badge, cache-miss flag |
| Call | `llm`: model + duration · `tool`: status, error, duration, argument head · `user`: prompt |
| Inspector | click any row: overview, arguments, raw result, source |
dsh-turn-trace README · What you see：The tab follows the DSH language setting (English / 中文); it does not guess from the browser.

dsh-turn-trace README · How it works：The view is **client-only**. It reads the chat snapshot the shell already holds
(`useChat` → `order` + `nodes`) and folds it into turns → steps → money. No host
plugin, no package-private RPC, no polling: the snapshot updates as the session
runs, so the view re-folds on every change.

dsh-turn-trace README · Pricing：Each call is priced from DeepSeek's published per-1M-token rates, using that call's own timestamp to pick peak or off-peak (peak: 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, weekdays). Rates live in [`src/pricing.ts`](src/pricing.ts) so they can be updated in one place. These are estimates, not billed amounts.

dsh-turn-trace README · Accuracy and limits：- **A step is priced from its own recorded model id** (`finalNode.requestConfig.model`, then `providerMetadata.model`). A step that carries no id inherits the nearest recorded model and is counted in the header; if the session recorded no model at all, the step stays unpriced instead of being guessed.
- Chinese public holidays are not modelled, so holiday sessions read slightly high.
- Only the loaded window is folded; **Older** pages older history in through the slot's `loadOlder`.

dsh-turn-trace README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test            # fold + pricing assertions, no runtime needed
pnpm test:activation # boot-safety: apply() must never throw (needs a build)
pnpm typecheck       # tsc --noEmit

The client bundle registers through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`;
`scripts/wrap-client.mjs` adds that envelope after the CJS build, so the browser
half uses the runtime's `require('react')` instead of bundling its own copy.

dsh-turn-trace README · Development：`lib/` is committed so `github:` installs work. After changing source, run
`pnpm build` and commit `lib/` with the change.
